{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''battle''' erupted at a traditional [[m'Yalfor'ac Order]] battle arena on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Guiteica/Legends|Guiteica]] when, following an unsuccessful [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempt by [[Bitthævrian/Legends|Bitthævrian]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Jael Ganton Farvash]] against [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Quaal Tavier Catharius]], the two fought a duel there. The victory of Tavier and [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Guardian (rank)|bodyguard]], [[Aul Tarrus Vishav]], over Ganton during the battle secured the status of the former pair as heroes among the Bitthævrian [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>
